package greet

import "strings"

// Farewell trims the name but returns a plain error for an empty one.
func Farewell(name string) (string, error) {
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if name == "" {
		return "", emptyFarewell{}
	}
	return "Goodbye, " + name + "!", nil
}

type emptyFarewell struct{}

func (emptyFarewell) Error() string { return "name is empty" }
